records.question: How has God spoken in the past?
records.answer: God has spoken in the past through the prophets at many times and in many ways.

records.question: How has God spoken in these recent days?
records.answer: God has spoken in these recent days through a Son.

records.question: Through whom were the ages made?
records.answer: The ages were made through the Son of God.

records.question: How are all things sustained?
records.answer: All things are sustained by the word of the Son of God’s power.

records.question: How does the Son display the glory and essence of God?
records.answer: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the representation of God’s essence.

records.question: How does the Son of God compare to the angels?
records.answer: The Son of God is far superior to the angels.

records.question: What did God command the angels to do when the Son was brought into the world?
records.answer: God commanded the angels to worship the Son when the Son was brought into the world.

records.question: How long will the Son rule as a king?
records.answer: The Son will rule as a king for ever and ever.

records.question: What does the Son love and what does the Son hate?
records.answer: The Son loves righteousness and the Son hates lawlessness.

records.question: What will happen to the earth and heavens over time?
records.answer: The earth and heavens will wear out like a garment and perish.

records.question: Where did God tell the Son to sit, and until what happened?
records.answer: God told the Son to sit at his right hand until God made the Son’s enemies a stool for the Son’s feet.

records.question: For whom do the angels care?
records.answer: The angels care for those who are going to inherit salvation.

records.question: Why must believers pay attention to what they have heard?
records.answer: Believers must pay attention to what they have heard so that they do not drift away from it.

records.question: What would every transgression and disobedience receive?
records.answer: Every transgression and disobedience would receive just punishment.

records.question: How did God testify to the message of salvation announced by the Lord?
records.answer: God testified to the message by signs, wonders, powerful deeds, and by the gifts of the Holy Spirit.

records.question: Who will not rule the world to come?
records.answer: Angels will not rule the world to come.

records.question: Who will rule the world to come?
records.answer: Man will rule the world to come.

records.question: Why was Jesus crowned with glory and honor?
records.answer: Jesus was crowned with glory and honor because of his suffering and death.

records.question: For whom did Jesus taste death?
records.answer: Jesus tasted death for every man.

records.question: Whom does God plan to bring to glory?
records.answer: God plans to bring many sons to glory.

records.question: Who are the two who come from the one source, God?
records.answer: Both the one who sanctifies and those who are sanctified come from the one source, God.

records.question: Who was made ineffective through Jesus’ death?
records.answer: The devil was made ineffective through Jesus’ death.

records.question: From what slavery are people freed through the death of Jesus?
records.answer: Through the death of Jesus, people are freed from the fear of death.

records.question: Why was it necessary for Jesus to be like his brothers in all ways?
records.answer: It was necessary so that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest over God’s things, and so he might obtain forgiveness for the people’s sins.

records.question: Why is Jesus able to help those who are tempted?
records.answer: Jesus is able to help those who are tempted because he was tempted also.

records.question: What two roles does the author of the book of Hebrews say Jesus fills?
records.answer: The author says Jesus is an apostle and a high priest.

records.question: Why has Jesus been considered worthy of greater glory than Moses?
records.answer: Jesus has been considered worthy of greater glory because, while Moses was faithful in all God’s house, Jesus is the one who built the house.

records.question: What was Moses’ role in God’s house?
records.answer: Moses was a servant in God’s house.

records.question: About what did Moses give testimony?
records.answer: Moses gave testimony about the things that were to be spoken of in the future.

records.question: What is Jesus’ role in God’s house?
records.answer: Jesus’ role is as a Son in charge of God’s house.

records.question: Who is God’s house?
records.answer: The believers are God’s house if they hold fast to their confidence.

records.question: What did the Israelites in the wilderness do when they heard God’s voice?
records.answer: The Israelites hardened their hearts.

records.question: What did God swear concerning the Israelites who went astray in their hearts?
records.answer: God swore that they would not enter his rest.

records.question: Of what are the brothers warned to be careful?
records.answer: The brothers are warned to be careful not to turn away from the living God by unbelief.

records.question: What are the brothers to do in order to avoid being hardened by the deceitfulness of sin?
records.answer: The brothers are to encourage one another daily.

records.question: As partners of Christ, what must believers do?
records.answer: As partners of Christ, believers must firmly hold their confidence in him from the beginning to the end.

records.question: With whom was God angry for 40 years?
records.answer: God was angry with those who sinned in the wilderness.

records.question: What happened to those with whom God was angry?
records.answer: Their dead bodies lay in the wilderness.

records.question: Why were the disobedient Israelites not able to enter God’s rest?
records.answer: They were not able to enter God’s rest, because of unbelief.

records.question: What good news had the believers and the Israelites both heard?
records.answer: The believers and the Israelites had both heard the good news about God’s rest.

records.question: Why did the good news not benefit the Israelites?
records.answer: The good news did not benefit the Israelites because they did not join in faith with those who believed it.

records.question: When did God finish his created works and then rest?
records.answer: God finished his created works at the beginning of the world and then rested on the seventh day.

records.question: Who are the ones who enter God’s rest?
records.answer: Those who have believed enter God’s rest.

records.question: What did God say about the Israelites and his rest?
records.answer: God said that the Israelites would not enter his rest.

records.question: What day has God now set for people to enter his rest?
records.answer: God has set “Today” as the day for people to enter his rest.

records.question: What must a person do in order to enter God’s rest?
records.answer: A person must listen to God’s voice and not harden his heart.

records.question: What is still reserved for God’s people?
records.answer: A Sabbath rest is still reserved for God’s people.

records.question: A person who enters God’s rest also rests from what?
records.answer: A person who enters God’s rest also rests from his works.

records.question: Why should believers be eager to enter God’s rest?
records.answer: Believers should be eager to enter God’s rest so that they do not fall into disobedience as the Israelites did.

records.question: What is the word of God sharper than?
records.answer: The word of God is sharper than any two-edged sword.

records.question: What is the Word of God able to divide?
records.answer: The Word of God is able to divide soul from spirit and joints from marrow.

records.question: What is the Word of God able to discern?
records.answer: The Word of God is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

records.question: Who or what is hidden from God’s sight?
records.answer: No created thing is hidden from God’s sight.

records.question: Who serves as the great high priest for believers?
records.answer: Jesus, the Son of God, serves as the great high priest for believers.

records.question: Why does Jesus feel sympathy for the weaknesses of believers?
records.answer: Jesus feels sympathy for the weaknesses of believers because he was in all ways tempted.

records.question: How many times did Jesus sin?
records.answer: Jesus never sinned. Jesus was without sin.

records.question: In time of need, what are believers to do to receive mercy and find grace?
records.answer: In time of need, believers are to approach with confidence to the throne of grace.

records.question: What does every high priest do on behalf of the people?
records.answer: For the people, every high priest offers gifts and sacrifices for sins.

records.question: In addition to the people, for whom does the high priest also present sacrifices?
records.answer: The high priest also presents sacrifices for his own sins.

records.question: How does a man receive the honor of being a high priest of God?
records.answer: A man must be called by God to be a high priest of God.

records.question: Who declared Christ to be a high priest?
records.answer: God declared Christ to be a high priest.

records.question: For how long is Christ God’s high priest?
records.answer: Christ is God’s high priest forever.

records.question: Of what order is Christ as a high priest?
records.answer: Christ is a high priest of the order of Melchizedek.

records.question: Why was Christ heard by God when he prayed?
records.answer: Christ was heard by God because of his godly life.

records.question: How did Christ learn obedience?
records.answer: Christ learned obedience from the things he suffered.

records.question: For whom did Christ become the cause of eternal salvation?
records.answer: For everyone who obeys him, Christ became the cause of their eternal salvation.

records.question: What was the spiritual condition of the original readers of this letter?
records.answer: The original readers were dull of hearing.

records.question: How does the author of the letter say that believers grow from spiritual babies into full-grown adults?
records.answer: Believers grow spiritually by practicing distinguishing right from wrong, discerning both good and evil.

records.question: What teachings does the author list as the foundation of the message of Christ?
records.answer: The foundational teachings are repentance from dead works, faith in God, baptisms, laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.

records.question: On to what does the author of Hebrews want the believers to go forward?
records.answer: The author of Hebrews wants the believers to go forward to maturity.

records.question: What is impossible for those who gained so much in Christ but then fell away, to do?
records.answer: It is impossible for those who gained so much in Christ, but then fell away, to be restored again to repentance.

records.question: What had these enlightened people gained?
records.answer: These enlightened people had tasted the heavenly gift, became sharers of the Holy Spirit, and tasted God’s Word and the powers of the age to come.

records.question: Why are these people not able to be restored to repentance?
records.answer: They are not able to be restored because they have crucified for themselves the very Son of God and exposed him to public shame.

records.question: In the author’s analogy, what happens to land that receives rain but bears thorns and thistles?
records.answer: Land that receives rain but bears thorns and thistles has its end in burning.

records.question: What is the author’s expectation concerning the believers to whom he is writing?
records.answer: The author expects better things concerning these believers, things that are about salvation.

records.question: What will God not forget about these believers?
records.answer: God will not forget their work, love of God, and service to the saints.

records.question: What should the believers imitate about those who inherit the promises of God?
records.answer: The believers should imitate the faith and patience of those who inherit the promises of God.

records.question: What did Abraham have to do in order to obtain what God promised him?
records.answer: Abraham had to wait patiently to obtain what God promised him.

records.question: Why did God guarantee his promise with an oath?
records.answer: God guaranteed his promise with an oath to show more clearly the unchangeable quality of his purpose.

records.question: What is it impossible for God to do?
records.answer: It is impossible for God to lie.

records.question: Where did Jesus enter as the forerunner for the believers?
records.answer: Jesus entered into the inner place behind the curtain as the forerunner for the believers.

records.question: What does the believer’s hope in God do for his soul?
records.answer: The believer’s hope in God is a secure and reliable anchor for his soul.

records.question: What two titles did Melchizedek have?
records.answer: Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High.

records.question: What did Abraham give Melchizedek?
records.answer: Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything he had captured.

records.question: What does the name Melchizedek mean?
records.answer: The name Melchizedek means “king of righteousness” and “king of peace.”

records.question: Who were the ancestors of Melchizedek, and when did he die?
records.answer: Melchizedek was without ancestors and has no end of life.

records.question: From whom are the priests descended who are priests according to the Law and who collect tithes from the people?
records.answer: The priests of the Law are descended from Levi, and before him, from Abraham.

records.question: Who was the greater person, Abraham or Melchizedek?
records.answer: Melchizedek was the greater person because he blessed Abraham.

records.question: In what way did Levi himself also pay tithes to Melchizedek?
records.answer: Levi also paid tithes to Melchizedek, because Levi was of the seed of Abraham, and Abraham paid tithes to Melchizedek.

records.question: What must also be changed when the priesthood changes?
records.answer: The law must be changed when the priesthood changes.

records.question: From which tribe did Jesus descend, and had this tribe served before at the altar as priests?
records.answer: Jesus descended from the tribe of Judah, which had never before served at the altar as priests.

records.question: On what basis did Jesus become a priest after the order of Melchizedek?
records.answer: Jesus became a priest after the order of Melchizedek based on the power of an indestructible life.

records.question: What has been set aside because it is weak and useless?
records.answer: The former commandment, the Law, has been set aside because it is weak and useless.

records.question: What oath did God swear concerning Jesus?
records.answer: God swore that Jesus would be a priest forever.

records.question: Of what is Jesus the guarantee?
records.answer: Jesus is the guarantee of a better covenant.

records.question: Why is Jesus able to completely save those who draw near to God through him?
records.answer: Jesus is able to completely save those who draw near to God through him because he always lives to intercede for them.

records.question: What four attributes does Jesus have that make him the right priest for believers?
records.answer: Jesus is holy, innocent, pure, and separated from sinners.

records.question: What offering did Jesus need to make for his own sins?
records.answer: Jesus did not need to make any offering for his own sins, because he is sinless.

records.question: What offering did Jesus make for the sins of the people?
records.answer: Jesus offered up himself once for the sins of the people.

records.question: How is Jesus different from the priests who were appointed through the Law?
records.answer: The priests who were appointed through the Law were weak, but Jesus has been made perfect forever.

records.question: Where is the believers’ high priest sitting?
records.answer: The believers’ high priest is sitting at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens.

records.question: Where is the true tabernacle?
records.answer: The true tabernacle is in the heavens.

records.question: What is necessary for every priest to have?
records.answer: Every priest must have something to offer.

records.question: Where were the priests who offered gifts according to the Law?
records.answer: The priests who offered gifts according to the Law were on the earth.

records.question: What did the priests on earth serve?
records.answer: The priests on earth served an example and a shadow of the heavenly things.

records.question: According to what pattern was the earthly tabernacle built?
records.answer: The earthly tabernacle was built according to the pattern God showed Moses on the mountain.

records.question: Why does Christ have a superior priestly ministry?
records.answer: Christ has a superior priestly ministry because he is the mediator of a better covenant, established on better promises.

records.question: What did God promise when he found fault with the people under the first covenant?
records.answer: God promised to make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.

records.question: What did God say he would do in the new covenant?
records.answer: God said he would put his laws into the people’s minds, and write them on their hearts.

records.question: In the new covenant, who will know the Lord?
records.answer: In the new covenant, all will know the Lord, from the least to the greatest.

records.question: What did God say he would do with the people’s sins in the new covenant?
records.answer: God said he would remember the people’s sins no more.

records.question: In announcing a new covenant, what did God make the first covenant?
records.answer: In announcing a new covenant, God made the first covenant obsolete, growing old and disappearing.

records.question: What was the place of worship for the first covenant?
records.answer: The place of worship for the first covenant was the earthly holy place which was called the “tabernacle.”

records.question: What was located in the holy place of the earthly tabernacle?
records.answer: In the holy place of the earthly tabernacle were the lampstand, the table, and the bread of the presence.

records.question: What was located in the most holy place of the earthly tabernacle?
records.answer: In the most holy place of the earthly tabernacle were the altar for incense and the ark of the covenant.

records.question: How often did the high priest enter the Holy of Holies, and what did he do before he entered?
records.answer: The high priest entered the Holy of Holies once each year, after making a blood sacrifice for himself and the people.

records.question: What served as an illustration in the present time for the readers of this letter?
records.answer: The earthly tabernacle and the gifts and sacrifices being offered there served as an illustration in the present time.

records.question: What were the offerings of the earthly tabernacle not able to do?
records.answer: The offerings of the earthly tabernacle were not able to perfect the worshiper’s conscience.

records.question: Until when were the regulations of the earthly tabernacle provided?
records.answer: The regulations of the earthly tabernacle were provided until the new order would be put in place.

records.question: What is different about the sacred tent in which Christ serves?
records.answer: The sacred tent in which Christ serves is more perfect, is not made by human hands, and does not belong to this created world.

records.question: What offering did Christ make, by which he entered the Holy of Holies?
records.answer: Christ made an offering of his own blood by which he entered the Holy of Holies.

records.question: What did Christ’s offering accomplish?
records.answer: Christ’s offering secured everlasting redemption for everyone.

records.question: What does Christ’s blood do for the believer?
records.answer: Christ’s blood cleanses the believer’s conscience from dead deeds to serve the living God.

records.question: Of what is Christ the mediator?
records.answer: Christ is the mediator of a new covenant.

records.question: What is required in order for a will to be in force?
records.answer: A death is required in order for a will to be in force.

records.question: What death was required for the first covenant?
records.answer: The death of calves and goats was required for the first covenant.

records.question: What cannot happen without the shedding of blood?
records.answer: Without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness of sins.

records.question: Where does Christ now appear on our behalf?
records.answer: Christ now appears in heaven itself, in the presence of God, on our behalf.

records.question: How many times must Christ offer himself to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself?
records.answer: Christ offers himself one time, at the end of the ages, to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

records.question: For every person, what happens after their death?
records.answer: After every person dies, they face the judgment.

records.question: For what purpose will Christ appear a second time?
records.answer: Christ will appear a second time for the salvation of those who wait eagerly for him.

records.question: What is the law as compared to the realities in Christ?
records.answer: The law is only a shadow of the realities in Christ.

records.question: Of what do the repeated sacrifices made through the law remind the worshipers?
records.answer: The repeated sacrifices made through the law remind the worshipers of sins committed year after year.

records.question: What is it impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to do?
records.answer: It is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

records.question: What did God prepare for Christ when Christ came into the world?
records.answer: God prepared a body for Christ.

records.question: What practice did God set aside when Christ came into the world?
records.answer: God set aside the first practice of the sacrifices offered according to the law.

records.question: What practice did God establish when Christ came into the world?
records.answer: God established the second practice of the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

records.question: For what is Christ waiting as he sits at the right side of God?
records.answer: Christ is waiting until his enemies are humbled and made a stool for his feet.

records.question: By his one offering, what has Christ done for those sanctified?
records.answer: Christ has perfected forever those who are sanctified by his one offering.

records.question: What is no longer required where there is forgiveness of sins?
records.answer: Additional sacrifices are no longer required where there is forgiveness of sins.

records.question: Into what place can believers now enter by Jesus’ blood?
records.answer: Believers can now enter the most holy place by Jesus’ blood.

records.question: What has been sprinkled and what has been washed in the believer?
records.answer: The believer’s heart has been sprinkled clean from an evil conscience, and his body has been washed with pure water.

records.question: To what must believers hold tightly?
records.answer: Believers must hold tightly to the confession of their hope.

records.question: What must believers do as they see the day drawing near?
records.answer: Believers must encourage one another more and more as they see the day drawing near.

records.question: What is the expectation of those who deliberately go on sinning after receiving the knowledge of the truth?
records.answer: The expectation of those who deliberately go on sinning after receiving the knowledge of the truth is judgment and a fiery zeal that consumes God’s enemies.

records.question: What does the person deserve who treats the blood of Christ, by which he was sanctified, as something unholy?
records.answer: The person who treats the blood of Christ by which he was sanctified as something unholy deserves punishment without mercy beyond the punishment given under the law of Moses.

records.question: To whom does vengeance belong?
records.answer: Vengeance belongs to the Lord.

records.question: How had the believers who received this letter reacted to the seizure of their possessions?
records.answer: The believers had accepted with joy the seizure of their possessions, knowing they had a better and everlasting possession.

records.question: What must the believer need not throw away so he may receive what God has promised?
records.answer: The believer needs to retain his confidence so he may receive what God has promised.

records.question: How will the righteous live?
records.answer: The righteous will live by faith.

records.question: What does God think of those who shrink back?
records.answer: God is not pleased with those who shrink back.

records.question: What is the author’s expectation for those who received this letter?
records.answer: The author’s expectation is that those who received this letter will have faith for keeping their souls.

records.question: What attitude does a person of faith have toward God’s promises that are yet to be fulfilled?
records.answer: A person of faith confidently expects and has certainty toward God’s promises that are yet to be fulfilled.

records.question: From what were the visible things of the universe created?
records.answer: The visible things of the universe were not made out of things that were visible.

records.question: Why did God praise Abel for being righteous?
records.answer: God praised Abel because Abel by faith offered God a more appropriate sacrifice than Cain did.

records.question: What must one who comes to God believe about God?
records.answer: One who comes to God must believe that God exists and that he rewards those who seek him.

records.question: How did Noah demonstrate his faith?
records.answer: Noah demonstrated his faith by building an ark to save his family according to God’s warning.

records.question: What promise did Abraham and Sarah receive by faith?
records.answer: Abraham and Sarah received by faith the power to conceive even when they were too old.

records.question: What did the ancestors of faith see from far off?
records.answer: The ancestors of faith saw and welcomed God’s promises from far off.

records.question: What did the ancestors of faith consider themselves on the earth?
records.answer: The ancestors of faith considered themselves strangers and aliens on the earth.

records.question: What has God prepared for those of faith?
records.answer: God has prepared a heavenly city for those of faith.

records.question: What did Abraham believe God would be able to do even as he offered up Isaac his only son?
records.answer: Abraham believed God would be able to raise up Isaac from the dead.

records.question: What did Joseph prophesy by faith when his end was near?
records.answer: Joseph prophesied of the departure of the children of Israel from Egypt when his end was near.

records.question: What did Moses choose to do by faith when he had grown up?
records.answer: Moses chose by faith to share mistreatment with God’s people, considering the disgrace of following Christ as greater riches.

records.question: What did Moses observe by faith in order to save the Israelites’ firstborn sons?
records.answer: Moses observed the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood by faith in order to save the Israelites’ firstborn sons.

records.question: What did Rahab do by faith which prevented her from perishing?
records.answer: Rahab by faith received the spies in safety, which prevented her from perishing.

records.question: What did some of the ancestors of faith accomplish in war?
records.answer: Some of the ancestors of faith conquered kingdoms, escaped the sword, became mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

records.question: What did some of the ancestors of faith suffer?
records.answer: Some of the ancestors of faith suffered torture, mocking, whippings, chains, imprisonments, stoning, sawing in two, death, and destitution.

records.question: Despite the faith of these ancestors, what did they not receive in their earthly lives?
records.answer: Despite the faith of these ancestors, they did not receive in their earthly lives what God had promised them.

records.question: With whom will the ancestors of faith receive the promises of God and be perfected?
records.answer: The ancestors of faith will receive the promises of God and be perfected with the new covenant believers in Christ.

records.question: Why should the believer throw off the sin that easily entangles him?
records.answer: The believer should throw off the sin that easily entangles him in order to run with endurance the race placed before him.

records.question: Why did Jesus endure the cross and despise its shame?
records.answer: Jesus endured the cross and despised its shame for the joy that was set before him.

records.question: How can a believer avoid becoming weary or fainthearted?
records.answer: By considering Jesus, who endured hateful speech from sinners, a believer can avoid becoming weary or fainthearted.

records.question: What does the Lord do to those whom he loves and receives?
records.answer: The Lord disciplines those whom he loves and receives.

records.question: What is a person who is without the Lord’s discipline?
records.answer: A person without the Lord’s discipline is an illegitimate child and not God’s child.

records.question: Why does God discipline his children?
records.answer: God disciplines his children for their good, so they can share in his holiness.

records.question: What does discipline produce?
records.answer: Discipline produces peaceful fruit of righteousness.

records.question: What should believers pursue with all people?
records.answer: Believers should pursue peace with all people.

records.question: What must not grow up and cause trouble and pollute many?
records.answer: A root of bitterness must not grow up and cause trouble and pollute many.

records.question: What happened to Esau when he desired to inherit the blessing with tears after selling his own birthright?
records.answer: Esau was rejected when he desired to inherit the blessing with tears after selling his own birthright.

records.question: For what did the Israelites beg at the mountain where God spoke?
records.answer: The Israelites begged that not another word be spoken to them.

records.question: To where do believers in Christ come instead of the mountain where the Israelites heard the voice of God?
records.answer: Believers in Christ come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God.

records.question: To whom do believers in Christ come?
records.answer: Believer in Christ come to God, the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous, and to Jesus.

records.question: To what assembly do believers in Christ come?
records.answer: Believers in Christ come to the assembly of all the firstborn registered in heaven.

records.question: What will happen to those who turn away from the one who warns them from heaven?
records.answer: Those who turn away will not escape from God.

records.question: What has God promised to shake?
records.answer: God has promised to shake the earth and the heaven.

records.question: What will the believers receive instead of the things that can be shaken?
records.answer: The believers will receive a kingdom that cannot be shaken.

records.question: How should believers serve God?
records.answer: Believers should serve God with reverence and awe.

records.question: Why should believers worship God in this way?
records.answer: Believers should worship God in this way because he is a consuming fire.

records.question: What have some done by welcoming strangers?
records.answer: Some have welcomed angels without knowing it.

records.question: How should believers remember those in prison?
records.answer: Believers should remember them as if they were in prison also, and as if their bodies were being mistreated also.

records.question: What must be respected by all?
records.answer: Marriage must be respected by all.

records.question: What does God do with the sexually immoral and adulterers?
records.answer: God judges the sexually immoral and adulterers.

records.question: How can a believer be free from the love of money?
records.answer: A believer can be free from the love of money because God has said he will never leave nor forsake him.

records.question: Who’s faith should believers imitate?
records.answer: Believers should imitate the faith of those who have led them and who have spoken God’s Word to them.

records.question: About what kind of strange teachings does the author warn the believers?
records.answer: The author warns the believers about strange teachings involving rules about food.

records.question: Where were the bodies of the animals used for sacrifice in the holy place burned?
records.answer: The bodies of the animals were burned outside the camp.

records.question: Where did Jesus suffer?
records.answer: Jesus suffered outside the city gate.

records.question: Where must believers go, and why?
records.answer: Believers must go to Jesus outside the camp, bearing his disgrace.

records.question: What permanent city do believers have here on earth?
records.answer: Believers have no permanent city here on earth. They seek the one coming.

records.question: What city do believers seek instead?
records.answer: Believers seek the city that is to come.

records.question: What sacrifice should believers constantly offer up to God?
records.answer: Believers should constantly offer up a sacrifice of praise to God.

records.question: What attitude should believers have toward their leaders?
records.answer: Believers should obey and submit to their leaders.

records.question: What does God work in the believer?
records.answer: God works in the believer that which is well pleasing in God’s sight.

records.question: With whom will the author come when he visits the believers?
records.answer: The author will come with Timothy when he visits the believers.
